page_title: AUG 0-0 HOF | Augsburg v Hoffenheim 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' The substitution has been made. Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) has replaced Dimitrios Giannoulis.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
88' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) prepares to take a corner kick.
87' The referee is firm and issues Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) a deserved yellow card.
85' Martin Petersen blows the whistle, Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) is penalised for a foul.
83' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
82' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. Augsburg win a corner.

81' A sweet pass finds Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Nediljko Labrovic is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
80' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
79' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
78' The referee signals a substitution. Tim Drexler (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Pavel Kaderabek.
78' That will be all from Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Valentin Gendrey.
75' Here comes a substitution. Steve Mounie (Augsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Alexis Claude-Maurice.
75' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) has tested the patience of referee Martin Petersen and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
73' A pass by David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
71' What was Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
69' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the right side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
68' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
67' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Phillip Tietz.
66' Jess Thorup has decided to substitute Arne Maier and he is replaced by Mert Komur (Augsburg).

65' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
65' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Martin Petersen signals.
63' Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
62' A short pass finds David Jurasek (Hoffenheim). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
61' Augsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
60' Here is a change. Umut Tohumcu is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marius Bulter departs the field of play to be replaced by Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim).
57' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
55' It looks like Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) saw red with that tackle. Martin Petersen won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
53' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
51' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) takes a short corner kick.
51' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim).
50' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
47' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Martin Petersen has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Hoffenheim are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
40' Arne Maier (Augsburg) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
40' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Augsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
35' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
34' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nediljko Labrovic, who smothers the ball.
33' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
32' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he arrows his header just a few inches wide of the right post.
31' Corner kick. Arne Maier (Augsburg) is ready to send the ball into the box.
27' Augsburg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
24' Half-chance! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) plays a pass into the box, but Nediljko Labrovic reacts well to snuff out the attack.
22' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
20' Nediljko Labrovic steps in and intercepts a long pass from David Jurasek (Hoffenheim).
19' Arne Maier (Augsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
17' A pass by David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
15' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nediljko Labrovic intercepts the ball.
15' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
11' The resulting corner from Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) is cleared by the defence.
11' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. Hoffenheim have a corner.

10' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) receives a pinpoint pass, takes one touch and produces a shot. It's a few inches shy of ending inside the left post. A great effort, though! It will be a corner kick for Hoffenheim.
8' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Arne Maier (Augsburg). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Augsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
7' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
5' Hoffenheim take a short corner kick.

4' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
1' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Martin Petersen had an easy-decision to make.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Hoffenheim will have the kick-off.
Martin Petersen is the one to supervise the game today.
